senses.sense_definition: To bring a vehicle or animal down to the ground or surface.

examples.text: The pilot managed to <w>land</w> the helicopter despite the strong winds.

target_lang_translations.nl: De piloot slaagde erin de helikopter te <w>landen</w> ondanks de harde wind.
target_lang_translations.pl: Pilotowi udało się <w>posadzić</w> helikopter pomimo silnego wiatru.
target_lang_translations.de: Dem Piloten gelang es trotz des starken Windes, den Hubschrauber zu <w>landen</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Le pilote a réussi à <w>poser</w> l'hélicoptère malgré les vents violents.
target_lang_translations.it: Il pilota è riuscito a <w>far atterrare</w> l'elicottero nonostante i forti venti.
target_lang_translations.cs: Pilotovi se podařilo s vrtulníkem <w>přistát</w> i přes silný vítr.
target_lang_translations.tr: Pilot, güçlü rüzgarlara rağmen helikopteri <w>indirmeyi</w> başardı.
target_lang_translations.es: El piloto logró <w>hacer aterrizar</w> el helicóptero a pesar de los fuertes vientos.

target_lang_translations.de: Der Fischer brauchte zwanzig Minuten, um den riesigen Lachs <w>an Land zu ziehen</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Il a fallu vingt minutes au pêcheur pour <w>sortir</w> l'énorme saumon.
target_lang_translations.it: Ci sono voluti venti minuti al pescatore per <w>tirare a riva</w> l'enorme salmone.
target_lang_translations.cs: Rybáři trvalo dvacet minut, než toho obrovského lososa <w>zdolal</w>.

senses.sense_definition: To succeed in acquiring or securing something desirable, such as a job or contract.

examples.text: She was thrilled to <w>land</w> a job at the prestigious company.

senses.sense_definition: To deliver a blow or punch successfully.

target_lang_translations.ru: Он пытался ударить меня, но удар не <w>достиг цели</w>.
target_lang_translations.nl: Hij probeerde me te slaan, maar de stoot <w>kwam niet aan</w>.

target_lang_translations.de: Er versuchte mich zu schlagen, aber der Schlag hat nicht <w>getroffen</w>.
target_lang_translations.fr: Il a essayé de me frapper, mais le coup n'a pas <w>touché</w>.

senses.sense_definition: To have the intended effect or be well received by an audience.
